name: mapstrlong
algorithm: Hash map churn with str keys of 24 to 200 bytes (paths and URLs, SH-2), otherwise the task of mapstr: the same programs (../mapstr/README.md) with longer keys.

skip.c: no standard hash map in C
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

notes: The sources are mapstr's; only the key lengths differ. Default string hashes as in mapstr: Mk the fold hash (two lanes from 32 bytes, SH-2), Rust SipHash-1-3 (RandomState), Zig Wyhash seed 0, Go the runtime AES hash.

Publish size 300000 20 1 24 200: at 10 rounds the fastest cell (Go) ran 0.59 s in the lane's informal hyperfine run (status/std-hash.md, session 2), so the rounds were doubled; about 1.2 s projected until a tools/bench publish times it.
Written by the std-hash lane (status/std-hash.md, session 2); checksums agree across all four columns at both sizes on the owner's machine, 2026-11-06.
